name: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science
description: Largest federal sponsor of basic research in the physical sciences; runs the DOE SBIR/STTR program and the national laboratory system.

name: DOE Office of Fusion Energy Sciences
description: DOE Office of Science program office for fusion energy and plasma science; administers INFUSE, the Milestone-Based Fusion Development Program, and FIRE Collaboratives.

name: DOE Office of Nuclear Energy
description: DOE program office for advanced fission; administers NEUP, GAIN vouchers, and NRIC.

name: Advanced Research Projects Agency-Energy (ARPA-E)
description: DOE agency funding high-risk, high-reward energy technology R&D, including fusion-relevant programs.

name: National Nuclear Security Administration
description: Semi-autonomous DOE agency; funds academic simulation consortia via PSAAP and cooperative agreements relevant to HED/ICF science.

name: National Science Foundation
description: Independent federal agency funding fundamental science and engineering; America's Seed Fund (NSF SBIR/STTR) funds deep-tech startups.

name: National Institutes of Health
description: Federal biomedical research agency; largest SBIR/STTR program in the civilian government.

name: National Aeronautics and Space Administration
description: Space agency; SBIR/STTR program funds aerospace-adjacent deep tech including power and propulsion.

name: U.S. Department of Defense
description: Largest federal SBIR/STTR spender across service branches (AFWERX, DIU, ONR, DARPA).

name: U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
description: Independent regulator for commercial nuclear; funds code development and university programs adjacent to licensing.
